name: Primary dystonia, DYT21 type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical diagnostic criteria for primary dystonia

criteria.description: Onset of dystonia symptoms typically in childhood or early adulthood
Exclusion of secondary causes of dystonia such as drug-induced or structural brain lesions
Identification of pathogenic variants in the DYT21-associated gene
Presence of sustained or intermittent muscle contractions causing abnormal postures or repetitive movements
Positive family history of dystonia or related movement disorders

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of dystonia symptoms with exclusion of secondary causes; genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to confirm diagnosis and guide counseling.

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; exclusion of metabolic or secondary causes
imaging: Brain MRI typically normal; used to exclude structural lesions
other: Electromyography showing co-contraction of antagonist muscles during dystonic movements

distinguishingFeatures: History of drug exposure or brain injury

redFlags: Presence of cognitive decline or dementia
Abnormal brain MRI findings suggestive of secondary causes
references: Orphanet: Primary dystonia, DYT21 type - ORPHA:306734

Albanese A, et al. Phenomenology and classification of dystonia: a consensus update. Mov Disord. 2013.
